rows.indian_institute_of_management_kozhikode: Consolidated Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 45,000 per month
Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, Kozhikode

Graduation/Post-Graduation in Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Advertising, English Literature or a related discipline, with minimum three (03) years' relevant experience in public relations, corporate communications, media organizations or a PR agency
Maximum 40 years (as on date of notification)

content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. C-85/2026-IIMK.HR gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIM Kozhikode notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduation/Post-Graduation in Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Advertising, English Literature or a related discipline; minimum three (03) years' relevant experience in public relations, corporate communications, media organizations, or a PR agency; demonstrated experience in news publications, media relations, content writing, social media management and institutional or corporate communications Experience: Minimum three (03) years' of relevant experience in public relations, corporate communications, media organizations, or a PR agency; demonstrated experience in news publications, media relations, content writing, social media management and institutional or corporate communications Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on date of notification) Other conditions: Excellent English writing, editing, proofreading and verbal communication skills Proficiency in social media content creation, editing tools and digital communication Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with content management systems and digital publishing tools Strong understanding of media relations, news values and public relations practices

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will automatically disqualify the candidate

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement purely on contract basis for a period of one year Further extension/s, if any, will depend upon performance/administrative requirements

rows.event: Last Date for Online Application (5:00 p.m.)

content_sections.heading: How Will IIM Kozhikode Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening and shortlisting based on details submitted in the application Interview of shortlisted candidates Candidates shortlisted based on details submitted in the application Eligible applications screened; only shortlisted candidates interviewed Interview time slots communicated by e-mail Engagement subject to verification of all certificates and experience at the time of joining Decision of the Director, IIMK regarding the selection shall be final

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit the application online at https://iimk.ac.in/ by 5:00 pm of 23.11.2026. Upload photograph, certificates, CV and signature as per the format prescribed in the online portal. Visit the website and check emails regularly for updates on the interview schedule.

content_sections.text: Applicants should visit the website and check emails regularly for interview schedule updates

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Public Relations Executive.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years (as on date of notification).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 45,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduation/Post-Graduation in Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Advertising, English Literature or a related discipline, with minimum three (03) years' relevant experience in public relations, corporate communications, media organizations or a PR agency.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Excellent English writing, editing, proofreading and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in social media content creation, editing tools and digital communication. Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with content management systems and digital publishing tools. Strong understanding of media relations, news values and public relations practices.

faq.answer: Canvassing in any form or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will automatically disqualify the candidate.

faq.answer: Screening and shortlisting based on details submitted in the application. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Candidates shortlisted based on details submitted in the application. Eligible applications screened; only shortlisted candidates interviewed.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement purely on contract basis for a period of one year. Further extension/s, if any, will depend upon performance/administrative requirements.
